entries.title: Captain of Industry
entries.definitive_edition: Captain of Industry on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Captain of Industry is a PC game available on Steam, with Windows support and a May 31, 2022 Early Access release. The Windows PC release is the only public platform and therefore the highest-fidelity and most-complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Early Access release on Steam.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced public release platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform split; the Windows PC Steam release is the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Captain of Industry remains an Early Access PC game; the full version is still planned and the Early Access build may change.
